logic_pc.rally: An empty R box suggests take-off less this time, and "+ In-time" fills in the same time. With no in-time or rally entered, a flyer's day starts here: his long day, OIL and Insights hours count from it. It also sets when the tight crew-rest advisory shows.
logic_pc.step: A man counts as busy from step: clashes and the crew list follow it. It and dekit set the shortest tight turn. It also decides when a LATE SHOW crew-rest ring turns from dashed to solid.
logic_pc.drawnA: An empty R box, a formation's rally, suggests a time this long before take-off, and "+ In-time" fills in that same time. When no in-time or rally is entered, a flyer's day starts at that time: his long day, OIL and Insights hours count from it. The tight crew-rest advisory also checks his rest as if he reported at that time.
logic_pc.drawnB: An empty R box, a formation's rally, suggests a time this long before take-off, and "+ In-time" fills in that same time. When no in-time or rally is entered, a flyer's OIL counts from that time, but his long day and Insights hours count from step. The tight crew-rest advisory also checks his rest as if he reported at that time.
